ink.use: Product and screen ground. Type, hairlines.

char.use: A true shade of Flare. 'Brand' in the wordmark, the needle, text on light (12:1), and the ground for everything physical.

ash.use: Tertiary text, neutral sentiment, unlit states.

danfo.use: A tint of Ember. Crescendo tails, lightest step on Ink.

ember.use: Middle of the ramp. Secondary planes, mid-scale data.

flare.use: Hero. 'Gauge' in the wordmark, head of every crescendo. Whole planes only.

ramp.meaning: A fire read cold to hot. Char is spent charcoal, Danfo the brightest yellow, Ember the glowing coal, Flare the flame. Grading stops for a crescendo are Danfo to Ember to Flare.

polarity.note: There is no green in this system. Deviation runs hot. Direction is carried by glyph, never by hue.

primary.use: Headlines, body, UI text. Tracking negative at display, zero at body, never positive.
primary.warning: Digits are proportional (1830 to 2900 units at 4000 upm). Nohemi can never set a column of figures.

display.use: All capitals (700, tracking .16 to .20em) and all numerals (400, tabular).
display.never: Body copy, headlines, or any run past two lines.
display.digitWidths: 696 to 697 units at 1000 upm. 0.024px drift at 60px. Effectively tabular.

type.pairing: Cap heights differ by 2 per cent, so the two set at the same pixel size with no optical correction.

needle.warning: The two blocks are parallel to each other, unlike the ticks which each face the pivot. Re-rotating them separately throws them 89 degrees out of parallel.

inkDuotone.use: Digital stories, anything where the claim is a number.

flareDuotone.use: Street stories. Offline attribution, OOH, field.

fullColour.use: People, as they are. Never duotone a face.

photography.readingStrip: Every image carries the number, the place, and the source count. If a picture cannot carry a reading, it does not go out.
